The '''Royal Palace''' on [[Hargeeva]] was the residence of the [[Hargeevan royal family]]. [[High King]] [[Makintay]] lived there, as did his son, [[Stevan Makintay|Stevan]] before he was disinherited for insisting on marrying a lowborn commoner, [[Ketrian Altronel]].
